name: question_item
description: Approved Parle placement question bank. Test-only demo items are clearly marked and are not human-reviewed production content.

demo_code.description: Stable demo-only item identifier used for deterministic selection

skill.description: Placement section that uses this item

prompt.description: Question prompt shown to the learner

passage.description: Reading text shown before the question, empty when not applicable

transcript.description: French transcript for transcript-only listening demo items

audio_url.description: Stored listening audio URL, empty until a real provider supplies audio

id.description: Stable option identifier used for scoring

text.description: Choice text displayed to the learner

options.description: Multiple-choice options. Existing text-only option arrays remain readable during migration.

answer_option_id.description: Stable identifier of the single correct option

answer.description: Legacy correct-answer text retained for migration and human-readable review

explanation.description: Short explanation of the correct answer

status.description: Content review state; approved demo items remain marked as test data

created_by_type.description: Content origin type; separate from Buildy's built-in created_by account field

reviewed_by.description: Review note; demo seeds are not human-reviewed production items

content_audit_version.description: Version of the administrator-reviewed question-bank repair

is_test_data.description: True for test-only content that must not be treated as production-approved
